Your lawn.
Our work.

Sixfold Colorado opens compacted ground with core aeration, seeds it while the holes are still open, and keeps it cut through the season — so the water you put on the lawn goes into it instead of off it.

Open ground.
Deeper roots.

aerate

Open the ground.

  • Core aeration, plugs two to three inches deep
  • Compacted lawns, worn paths, high-traffic ground
  • Plugs left on the surface to break back down
  • Walked and counted before anything is quoted
  • Spring and fall are the windows
overseed

Put seed where it works.

  • Overseeding straight after the pass
  • Seed into open holes, not onto thatch
  • Fertilizer down with it
  • Thin patches and worn strips
  • What to water, and when, before we leave
maintain

Keep it that way.

  • Mowing and edging
  • Seasonal clean-up and haul-away
  • Brush, plants and trees taken out
  • Land clearing when the lot needs it
  • One crew, one invoice
